project.description:
Daily table-churn report (read-only).
Triggered by Unload-Database_d. Snapshots every table of the live database (row count, content hash, meaningful-content "real" hash, per-row hashes) as a READ-ONLY role, compares it with the previous day's snapshot, and refreshes index.csv / unchanged_since.csv. Nothing is restored or loaded.
Each build publishes the "Table Churn Dashboard" (heatmap of real churn, today's unusual changes) and puts the unusual changes at the top of the email. Small permanent files (snapshots, reports, index) go to CHURN_DATA_DIR; the large per-row hash files (~5 GB/day, only the newest day kept) go to CHURN_HASH_DIR, so they can live on cheaper disk. See doc/compare-database-loads.md ("Daily job").

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: CHURN_DATA_DIR
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Small, permanent output (snapshots, reports, index). Blank = /research/zunloads/table_churn/$INSTANCE

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: CHURN_HASH_DIR
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Large per-row hash files (~5 GB/day, newest day kept). Blank = CHURN_DATA_DIR/hashes

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: CHURN_PGUSER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Read-only database role to connect as (password in the Jenkins user's ~/.pgpass). The job refuses a role that can write.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
export CHURN_DATA_DIR="${CHURN_DATA_DIR:-/research/zunloads/table_churn/$INSTANCE}" export CHURN_HASH_DIR="${CHURN_HASH_DIR:-$CHURN_DATA_DIR/hashes}" export PGUSER="$CHURN_PGUSER" export UNLOADS_DIR="/research/zunloads/databases/$INSTANCE"
cd $TARGETROOT bash server_apps/DB_maintenance/postgres/daily_table_churn.sh
# Archive the newest report, the summaries and the dashboard with the build. mkdir -p build/table-churn rm -rf build/table-churn/* latest=$(ls -t "$CHURN_DATA_DIR"/reports/*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true) cp "$CHURN_DATA_DIR"/index.csv "$CHURN_DATA_DIR"/unchanged_since.csv build/table-churn/ [ -n "$latest" ] && cp "$latest" build/table-churn/ cp "$CHURN_DATA_DIR"/dashboard/* build/table-churn/
n=$(wc -l < build/table-churn/anomalies.txt) echo "Unusual changes today: $n" [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && cat build/table-churn/anomalies.txt
